claim: Patchline ships a streaming differential analyzer that reports hazard deltas between any two repo revisions. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the hazard delta claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make streaming-differential-analyzer-gate`.
